about_the_game:
Add classic fantasy flavor to your game with these merfolk walking character sprites!
This set includes merfolk with four different tail fin designs, ready to swim into your next RPG adventure.

■ Contents:

  • Merfolk: Short hair, long hair, clothed/unclothed variations × 8 colors

  • Mermaids: Short hair (1 bang variation), long hair (1 bang variation), 3 outfit variations × 8 colors

  • Merchildren: 4 boy types, 2 girl types × 4 colors

  • Friends: 1 sheet

--------------------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
